CHAPTER 5 · ITEM 08 / 11

Supply elasticity and applications

Supply elasticity供給彈性

YOUR CHECKBOX · 原始清單項目

Calculate price elasticity of supply using percentage changes and explain why supply is often more elastic over a longer horizon.

01 · UNDERSTAND / 概念解釋

供給彈性用供給量百分比反應除價格百分比變化。長期可改變設備、投入或企業數目，通常更有彈性。

Supply elasticity is the percentage quantity supplied response divided by the percentage price change. A longer horizon often permits new capacity, entry or changed inputs, making supply more elastic; this is a tendency, not a universal law.

02 · WORKED EXAMPLE / 一個示範

See it in action.

Example 例：P rises 10%, Qs rises 20%; Es=2. Firms may respond more over a year than over a day. 供給反應大於價格變化。

03 · TRY IT / 例題練習

One question. Your turn.

A 5% price rise increases supply by 15%. Es? 供給彈性？
